newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan loan programme has no problem loans - PM.
newsitem.headline: Japan loan programme has no problem loans - PM.

text.p: Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto told parliament's Upper House on Wednesday that the government's fiscal loan and investment programme, which lends money to government-affiliated financial institutions, has no problem loans.

Hashimoto made the remark in response to a question about whether the programme had problem loans similar to those of private financial institutions, which are burdened with massive unrecoverable loans.

The programme uses funds collected from the public in the form of pension and postal savings to make loans to quasi-governmental financial institutions, such as the Export-Import Bank and Housing Loan Corp.
"We try to manage funds of the programme effectively because they are collected from the public. The programme does not have so-called problem loans," Hashimoto said.
